F1.name: PRIMARY_NAME
F1.label: Name
F1.desc: Member's first (usual) name - the form splits Name into first and last

F3.name: PRIMARY_BRANCH_NAME
F3.label: Branch
F3.desc: Member's branch. CHECK: name or number? PRIMARY_BRANCH is the number

F4.name: TRACE_REASON_NO_FUNDS
F4.label: Member didn't receive any funds
F4.custom: At least one Reason for trace box must be ticked (TRACE_REASON_NO_FUNDS, _PARTIAL_FUNDS, _DECLINED_DEBITED, _DEBITED_TWICE, _NOT_RECOGNIZED, _OTHER)

F6.name: TRACE_REASON_DECLINED_DEBITED
F6.label: Transaction said decline but still debited account

F7.name: TRACE_REASON_DEBITED_TWICE
F7.label: Account debited twice for same transaction

F8.name: TRACE_REASON_NOT_RECOGNIZED
F8.label: Member does not recognize the transaction

F11.name: BRANCH_TRACE_CONTACT
F11.label: Branch contact name for trace
F11.desc: Staff member Central 1 should contact. Could be REQUESTUSER if it is always the person filling the form

F12.name: ATM_TRANSACTION_DATE
F12.label: Date of ATM transaction
F12.custom: Either the ATM section (ATM_TRANSACTION_DATE, _AMOUNT, ATM_UNIT_ID, ATM_PAN_NUMBER, ATM_TRACER_NUMBER) or the POS section must be filled in

F13.name: ATM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
F13.label: Amount of ATM transaction
F13.custom: Required when the ATM section is used (ATM_TRANSACTION_DATE filled in)

F15.name: ATM_PAN_NUMBER
F15.label: PAN number used for the transaction (if available)
F15.desc: Card number (PAN) used at the ATM

F16.name: ATM_TRACER_NUMBER
F16.label: Tracer number for the transaction
F16.desc: Tracer number of the ATM transaction

F17.name: POS_TRANSACTION_DATE
F17.label: Date of POS transaction
F17.custom: Either the POS section (POS_TRANSACTION_DATE, _AMOUNT, POS_UNIT_ID, POS_PAN_NUMBER, POS_TRACER_NUMBER) or the ATM section must be filled in

F18.name: POS_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
F18.label: Amount of POS transaction
F18.custom: Required when the POS section is used (POS_TRANSACTION_DATE filled in)

F19.name: POS_UNIT_ID
F19.label: ATM unit identification number
F19.desc: Terminal identification number (the form says ATM unit under POS)

F20.name: POS_PAN_NUMBER
F20.label: PAN number used for the transaction (if available)
F20.desc: Card number (PAN) used at the POS

B3.name: POS_TRACER_NUMBER
B3.label: Tracer number for the transaction
B3.desc: Tracer number of the POS transaction - the form had no box for it
